issues.extracted: business-type receipts/disbursements and business_type beginning 6,115,005 / ending 6,646,822 from the modified cash Statement of Activities (p2); detail from the accrual proprietary statement (p6)
issues.on_page: Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Net Position - Business-type Activities (p6) Total column: User fees 2,317,026; Miscellaneous income 227,641; Gain on sale of capital assets 5,500; Interest income 126,064; operating expenses by cost type totalling 1,605,580; Interest expense (60,416); Beginning net position 13,917,897; Ending net position 14,928,132
issues.issue: Business-type statement lines and balances must come from the proprietary funds statement total column (p6), the same statement the utility detail uses. The extraction mixes bases: statement lines/balances are modified cash (p2) while detail is accrual (p6). Waverly_FY2024 uses the accrual p6 statement (business_type.beginning 14,928,132 = this report's p6 ending), so the two years are NOT on the same basis: FY2023 business_type.ending 6,646,822 does not equal FY2024 business_type.beginning 14,928,132 and no restatement explains it. Fix: take p6 Total column (receipts 2,317,026 + 227,641 + 5,500 + 126,064 = 2,676,231; disbursements 1,605,580 + 60,416 = 1,665,996; beginning 13,917,897; ending 14,928,132; ties: 13,917,897 + 2,676,231 - 1,665,996 = 14,928,132).
issues.resolved: business-type from p6 Total column; Taxes split by fund

issues.on_page: Taxes: General 1,677,094; Debt Service 806,107; City Sales Tax 828,698; Other Governmental Funds 665,765; Total 3,977,664
issues.issue: The City Sales Tax Fund's Taxes 828,698 have a clear fund-name tax type, so under the tax-split rule the statement line should be split: sales tax 828,698 (computed: tax type from fund name City Sales Tax) plus taxes remainder 3,148,966 (split_from 'Taxes 3,977,664 (p4)'). The detail already classifies this column as sales tax, and Waverly_FY2024 splits its statement line the same way.
issues.resolved: business-type from p6 Total column; Taxes split by fund

issues.on_page: FY2023 p4 ending fund balance 9,933,058 (Other Governmental Funds 1,542,028); FY2024 report prints beginning 9,933,060 (Other Governmental Funds 1,542,030)
issues.issue: FY2023 ending fund balance does not equal Waverly_FY2024 beginning_fund_balance; it is $2 off, and the FY2024 report prints no restatement. Both are recorded as printed, which is correct; the difference is in the FY2024 report.

'Lottery' is a context label (category_decisions apply=context), so the context check settles it. Waverly_FY2024 records the same line as category other (detail_category keno/lottery), so the two years are currently inconsistent.
